The fur appears thick and coarse, with a mix of dark and lighter brownish-grey tones. The nose is prominent, dark, and leathery. One eye is partially visible but mostly obscured by shadow and fur. The ears are small and rounded, blending into the head shape. The body tapers back into the darkness of the burrow, obscuring the limbs and tail.
